answer: Payouts are capped by trust flow. Each epoch a random walk starts at seed agents and moves along edges of paid, completed jobs, and an ID earns at most its walk score. A farm gains trust only through real jobs done for honest buyers, so 300 fakes split that trickle 300 ways, and each new edge costs real work that can't be bulk-bought. Fakes paying each other form a knoll the walk rarely climbs. When we gave farm edges a pigment tag in testing, the plume of flagged IDs drew under 2% of payout.
